title: [Builder] clocking.audio_pll_hz, clocking.sampling_rate_hz and audio_interface.word_length_bits are declared but the SoC elaborates 48 kHz, 32-bit slots and the fixed 24.576 MHz MMCM plan

milestone.title: Software Defined Stack
milestone.description: Every aspect of the milan stack should be at compile time software definable.

body:
Found by the milestone 4 declaration audit at dev f46215cf (m4-audit/REPORT.md, section 2.4).

## Objective and evidence

Three clock-plan keys validate, print into the build plan, and reach no elaboration:

- `clocking.audio_pll_hz` is read at `sw/builder/endstation_builder.py` line 3337. Its consumers are the AES3 divisibility check (lines 3570 to 3579) and the plan text (line 4609). `emit_design_opts` (lines 3985 to 4039) emits no flag for it, `sw/litex/milan_soc.py` has no argument for it, and the audio MMCM plan is fixed at `milan_soc.py` lines 256 to 327. `docs/ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md` row 13 (line 847) names the SoC as its consumer.
- `clocking.sampling_rate_hz` reaches the AEM (AUDIO_UNIT current rate, stream formats) and the SRP arithmetic. The SoC fixes `AUDIO_IF_FS_HZ = 48000` (`milan_soc.py` line 90) and never sets the datapath's `AUDIO_IF_FS_HZ_P` (default 48000 at `hdl/milan/milan_datapath.sv` line 127; `milan_soc.py` lines 827 and 922 to 925 pass only SLOTS, MASTER and CLK). `hdl/ieee1722/crf/KL_crf_tx.sv` line 193 and `milan_datapath.sv` line 4857 carry 48000 and 6 samples per PDU. The builder marks any other rate planned (lines 3875 to 3886) and builds anyway, so a 96 kHz config yields a model at 96 kHz over a fabric at 48 kHz.
- `audio_interface.word_length_bits` is validated (lines 3540 to 3542) and used only for the AES3 `WORD_BITS_P` (line 2839). For the TDM family `milan_soc.py` lines 83 to 89 fix 32-bit slots and `milan_datapath.sv` line 796 has `AIF_WORD_BITS_C = 32`; the front-ends expose `WORD_BITS_P` (`hdl/ieee1722/aaf/KL_tdm_capture_master.sv` line 83) that nothing sets.
- `clocking.audio_unit_rates_hz: [48000, 96000, 192000]` in `configs/endstation_arty_current.yaml` line 141 advertises SET_SAMPLING_RATE targets the render path cannot run; only the current rate gets a mark.

## Authority and scope

- `docs/ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md` D5 and rows 7, 8, 13 and 15; Milan v1.2 6.2 (base rates) and 5.3.3.3 (AUDIO_UNIT truth).
- A decision first, per key: drive (an argv flag consumed by `milan_soc.py` and passed to `AUDIO_IF_FS_HZ_P`, `AUDIO_IF_CLK_HZ_P` and the TDM `WORD_BITS_P`, proven by the gate 23 family down to `Instance()`), or refuse (a `ConfigError` for any value other than the one the SoC elaborates, replacing the planned mark for the rate and the silent acceptance for the other two). The 48 kHz-only render path is roadmap item 6; refusing satisfies this milestone.

Out of scope: the MMCM-DRP media-clock servo (item 6), the AES3 and S/PDIF SoC plumbing, any change to the values the shipping bitstreams elaborate.

## Acceptance and validation

1. No key under `clocking:` or `audio_interface:` is accepted without reaching an argv flag that a gate 23 series test proves at an `Instance()` parameter, or a `ConfigError`; `sw/builder/test_builder.py` gains the negative case for each of the three keys.
2. The five tracked configs emit byte-identical `soc_params.json` and sweep fragments (gates 2 and 9) unless the decision adds a flag, in which case the fragments regenerate and `scripts/check_sweep_shape.py` passes.
3. Each `audio_unit_rates_hz` entry the fabric cannot run is refused or carried as its own planned mark in `build_plan.md`.
4. ENDSTATION_BUILDER.md rows 7, 8, 13 and 15 name the real consumer; docs gates pass; no em dash on added lines.

## Lane and review

Executor: unassigned. Independent reviewer: unassigned. Assigned by the manager when the lane opens.
